notes.title: English Update
notes.notes:
The majority of the English text for this game has been edited and should now be more readable. Some more small text improvements will be made in the coming days.

NOTICE: a new moderator has become a part of the ZOV team who will be relating to the English audience of this game on the Steam Community Forums and will be announcing new patches and updates in the future.

We are aware of numerous bugs that players have been having and are working to fix them and to improve the game overall.

Any bugs that are found can be posted on this discussion:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/484950/discussions/0/359543951728791001/

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: BIG VERSION UPDATED! 超极本版更新！
notes.notes:
Fixed many bugs that people have been reporting and overall changes: 
-improve game operation
-changed the gamepad controls (attack : RT->gamepad X)
-changed some overall gameplay elements (such as disable the monster horror attack after it dies)
-the local files are open so you can access the local game contents such as the games images.

Thank you for everyones continued support and we will try to address bugs as soon as possible!



Just a reminder that any unofficial 'uncensored' patches are not supported and may damage your game.
Only the Steam version of Evil Maze is supported!
----------------------------------------------------------
修复很多游戏细节和bugs

调整用户的手柄操作体验：
更改游戏按键！RT->手柄X

修复大家反应最多的怪物死后的神秘一击！

等等…………

游戏中源文件开放
玩家可以自由编辑游戏目录下的图片 你懂的

notes.title: NEW VERSION RELEASED 【版本更新】
notes.notes:
A new update is out! It fixes numerous issues: 

- Reduced the difficulty of the tenth level. 

- Enlarged all the in-game fonts from 22 to 26. 

- Fixed buff effects of some monsters. 

- Small changes to some parts of the maps. 

- Modification of some of the dialogue. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
NOTE:
Because of some limitations of the RPGMaker engine, we have limited functionality for taking screenshots. 
We are looking into how we can improve this. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

We are working hard on fixing the issues players are having with the game! 
Thank you for sticking with us! 

降低了游戏前期难度
增大字体到22-26
修正了部分怪兽的buff效果
细微改变了部分地图内容
修改了结局对话的顺序

notes.title: New version released!
notes.notes:
A new update is live which addresses a few problems:

- The word 'silver' in achievement now actually says silver.

- Some fonts increased from 22 to 27.
 
- added screenshot functionallity by pressing the F5 key on the keyboard.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Because of some limitations of the RPGMaker engine, we have limited functionallity for the screenshots.
We are looking into how we can improve this.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
